comparison_to_post_q4_pair_profile.interpretation: The exact octet producer accounts for 86.51% of the net kernel-sum reduction. Other major families move by at most 1.76%, consistent with one-shot profiler clock drift. Authoritative wall evidence remains the published counterbalanced full-engine A/B, not either profiler wall.

next_lane.selected: direct BF16 rocBLAS output epilogue for the bounded source-F16 composite
next_lane.reason: The remaining source-F16 operation boundary totals 153.003667 ms / 29.62% of M512 kernel sum across activation cast, Q4/Q5/Q6 producers, rocBLAS, and output cast. Every one of its 744 tile GEMMs currently publishes FP16 to an output scratch and then launches a strided FP16-to-BF16 conversion. A rocBLAS GEMM_EX D=BF16 path with FP16 A/B and FP16 compute can potentially publish the same final BF16 bytes directly into the final strided tile, eliminating the separate output cast and output scratch while preserving the sole-resident T16 payload and changed-arithmetic boundary.
next_lane.first_gate: Add a temporary runtime-unwired rocBLAS direct-BF16-output leaf with explicit destination leading dimension. Compare against current FP16-output plus BF16-cast on actual admitted Q4/Q5/Q6 roles at M512/1024/4096 on both gfx1100 boards. Require byte-exact BF16 output, zero rocBLAS errors, complete-chain wins, and no additional workspace. Stop at the leaf on any unsupported or mismatching shape.
next_lane.immediate_cast_ceiling: 4.120709 ms / 0.798% of M512 kernel sum across 744 launches; direct destination publication may also remove the 3.0-MiB logical output tile scratch, but no throughput or tracked-memory saving is assumed before measurement.
next_lane.why_now: The fresh 512 raw-HIP gap is only 1.228%, so operation-boundary work can be binding even though the cast-only ceiling was previously insufficient. This is not a cast-only kernel tune: it tests eliminating an entire producer-consumer handoff from the dominant source-F16 chain.
excluded_by_fresh_profile: Do not reopen Q5 MMQ, row reuse, or producer ownership; the octet route is exact and now only 0.76% of kernel sum.
Do not reopen dual-Q4 geometry, remaining exact-Q4 singleton source-F16, GDN, attention, or launch-count-only work; prior cross-board evidence closes those mechanisms.
Do not widen FFN-down tiles by allocating extra transient planes; prior candidates need 61-346 MiB and violate the no-memory-regression constraint.

decision: Retain the qualified natural-octet Q5 producer unchanged, publish its reconciled 4.362-ms producer saving, and screen direct byte-exact BF16 destination publication inside the bounded source-F16 rocBLAS chain next. This profile changes no production path and makes no new throughput claim.
